In FY2024, the foundation generated <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $2,087,958</cite> to support its local youth mentoring and athletic initiatives. The charity directs resources toward local youth programming, achieving a <cite id="2">Program expense ratio of 80.5%</cite>, which meets and exceeds the standard 75% program-ratio benchmark.
